name: com.evernote.android.job.patched.internal.v14.PlatformAlarmReceiver
description: When a scheduled alarm fires, the patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit routes it to the matching background task; MapKit uses this scheduler for offline-map downloads.
disableEffect: Offline-map download jobs using the library's alarm fallback may not start when due.
